body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics presented its portable DLP projector 'DX420' during CES 2009, which supports XGA(1024*768) resolution, 2,000 ANSI lumens and 28dB of noise level.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
